messages:
sre-bot: [ALERT] p99 latency spike detected on /v1/generate/stream — streaming stalls observed, SLO breach for p95/p99. KV cache pressure / fragmentation signals high eviction rate. metric: streaming.p99 = 2.3s (target 0.5s), eviction.rate up 7x

matt: ack — oncall here. getting dashboards now. @sam you free to pair? :eyes:

sam: on it. pulling prefill vs decode histograms. looks like prefill queue depth jumped ~5x at 10:13 UTC, decode workers steady. suspect prefill overload + slab fragmentation.

anya: quick note from ops: a couple of high-traffic customers (cust-A, cust-C) reporting timeouts and repeated reconnects. customer-ops is triaging messages already.

kyle: copying key metrics:
```
streaming.p95: 1.1s -> 1.9s
streaming.p99: 0.5s -> 2.3s
kv_cache.evictions_per_min: 120 -> 840
kv_cache.fragmentation_pct: 18% -> 62%
prefill.queue_len: 40 -> 210
decode.worker_util: 72% -> 78%
```

matt: thanks. initial hypothesis: frequent small requests are causing many short-lived KV entries -> slab fragmentation -> prefill is scanning more pages -> increased latency. also prefill path heavier than decode currently.

sam: running quick grep in runtime logs for "prefill_skipped" and "evict_reason=frag". found repeated lines: `evict_reason=slab_frag, slab_id=7, freed=8` every few seconds.

anya: are there any recent deploys to cache or prefill?

sam: no code deploys in last 2h. config change? checking console... nothing. autoscaler? no.

kyle: looks like policy change from last week (eviction_threshold lowered) might be biting us under recent traffic pattern shift. rollback candidate.

matt: mitigation plan (short term):
- throttle prefill concurrency to reduce stress on slab allocator
- bump kv cache slab reclaim interval to reduce fragmentation churn
- route ~20% traffic to fallback model variant (lower memory footprint) to relieve hot shards
- notify customers with ETA 30m

sam: commands to apply throttling (run with caution):
```
# reduce prefill concurrency
redwoodctl config set runtime.prefill.max_concurrency 8 --env prod
# increase slab reclaim interval
redwoodctl config set kvcache.slab_reclaim_interval_ms 60000 --env prod
```

anya: do we have a playbook for routing fallback?

kyle: yes — runbook link: https://console.redwood.internal/playbooks/kv-cache-pressure. will execute route change via routing service.

sam: applied prefill throttle and slab interval change (diff below). watching metrics. applied at 10:25 UTC.

sre-bot: Automated: config change accepted; rollout id=r-98321; staged across 4/8 runtime nodes.

matt: watching p99 — sam any dashboards?

sam: p99 dropped from 2.3s -> 1.2s in 3m, p95 trending down as well. eviction rate down to ~260/min. still above baseline but improving.

customer-ops: notified customers A and C, they acknowledged and are monitoring. one enterprise customer asked for incident bridge; offered to escalate if they see more timeouts.

anya: any streaming stalls persisted?

sam: some tail stalls remain on nodes with high slab fragmentation. I'm kicking targeted slab compaction job on those nodes. command: `redwoodctl debug kvcache compact --shard=shard-7` (non-blocking).

kyle: agree on follow-ups:
- schedule background compaction to run during low traffic window
- revert eviction_threshold change from last week or tune back slowly
- add a telemetry alert for prefill:decode imbalance ratio > 3x

matt: handoff plan: I'm going offline in 20m. @oncall-next please take oncall and continue watch for the next 2h. checklist to follow in thread.

oncall-next: taking over. received current config diffs and run ids. will keep the bridge open and escalate to eng-runtime if p99 > 1.5s for 15m.

sam: leaving logs/snippet for oncall:
```
# nodes with >50% fragmentation
node-12 shard-7 frag=68%
node-19 shard-3 frag=59%
node-22 shard-7 frag=71%

# recent error samples
[stream:error] client=cid-9923 reason=stream_stall duration_ms=1800
[stream:warn] prefill_latency=820ms decode_latency=120ms
```

matt: impact summary to include in incident report:
- duration: 10:12 -> ongoing (mitigated to partial)
- customer impact: elevated p99 and reconnects for subset of streaming customers (cust-A, cust-C), retries mitigated most errors
- root cause (working): KV cache slab fragmentation + prefill:decode imbalance caused high eviction churn -> page scanning and stalls on streaming path
- mitigations: throttle prefill, bump reclaim interval, route partial traffic to fallback, targeted slab compaction

customer-ops: will collect customer logs and patch customer-facing incident update for 10:45 UTC. recommending note: "We observed streaming latency increases affecting a subset of customers; mitigations in progress, no data loss."

oncall-next: I'll keep watch on these signals: streaming.p99, kv_cache.evictions_per_min, prefill.queue_len, slab.fragmentation_pct. escalate if any exceed thresholds: p99>1.5s for 15m or eviction_rate>600/min continuously.

sam: leaving a small follow-up TODO: run controlled load test tomorrow to reproduce fragmentation pattern, and plan slab allocation tweak release with canary.

matt: thanks team. closing active mitigation window in 40m if metrics remain stable. will file postmortem draft and assign owners: root cause owner = eng-runtime (kyle), telemetry owner = eng-sre (anya), customer comms = customer-ops.

sre-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated_partial, severity=sev2, incident_id=INC-2026-482. next update in 30m or on request. :white_check_mark:"
